steps: Working tree: balance v52, skills v6 (38 nodes), no code edits.
Run: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out_dir> <tag> decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=mil (qa/bots/more_skills_signoff.sh arm reg_mil).
Repeat: identical result in 3 of 3 runs (rep_a, rep_b, batch).
Attribution: same run with --skip-skill=FND_BULK wins at cycle 27 (cash 19832); with all 7 new nodes removed it wins at 27 (cash 20431, equal to HEAD data).
bugs.expected: Decent mil-focus run wins at cycle 27 to 32 (last round 27, 27, 32, 27).
bugs.actual: END_SWEPT loss at cycle 27: final cash 524, mil share 0.074, 5 ships, FND_BULK learned at cycle 2 to 4. The same seed with FND_BULK removed wins at 27 (kept run to 39, cash 19832).

steps: Working tree: balance v52, skills v6.
Run: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out_dir> <tag> decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=bio (arm reg_bio).
Repeat: identical in 2 of 2 runs.
Attribution: removing FND_BULK alone still gives soft at 40 (cash 489); removing BIO_5B alone also gives soft at 40; removing both gives win at 27 (cash 36490), the same as HEAD data.
Removing MIL_5B, LUX_5B, LUX_6B or MIN_5B changes nothing (never learned in bio focus).
bugs.expected: Decent bio-focus run wins at cycle 27 (last round 27 for seed 4).
bugs.actual: END_OUTCOMPETED soft at the cycle-40 gate: no win, final cash 489, bio share 0.197, 6 ships. Bio seeds 1 to 3 win at 27.

steps: Run: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out_dir> <tag> decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=lux (arm reg_lux) and the same with --skip-skill=LUX_5B (arm nat_LUX_5B).
Compare event_rows (cycle, event id) of the two RESULT lines. Repeated for seeds 1 to 4 and in the branch arm (brb_lux_base vs brb_lux_5B).
Code path: game/main.gd about lines 2151 to 2155 (Skills.warning_cycles, then events.random_id draws from the event rng two cycles early); game/events.gd:278-286.
bugs.expected: LUX_5B is information only (reveal prices and a 2-cycle event warning). The realised event sequence should not change.
bugs.actual: The realised event sequence differs in 4 of 4 seeds (seed 1 first difference at cycle 13: EV43 with the node, EV02 without at cycle 21). Win cycle and share move as a result (seed 2: no win without the node, share 0.04 vs 0.53).

steps: Run: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out_dir> dom always_expand 3 --skip-tutorial (no keep-running, as the 2026-11-05 dominance arm).
Working tree: balance v52, skills v6.
Repeat: identical in 3 of 3 runs.
bugs.expected: Non-decent strategies do not win (last round: sloppy, always_expand and never_expand 0 of 12).
bugs.actual: always_expand wins at cycle 39 (final cash 24311, 6 ships). The other 11 non-decent runs do not win. Last round 0 of 12.

steps: Working tree: qa/bots/skill_signoff_one.sh <out_dir> <tag> decent <seed> --skip-tutorial --keep-running=38 --market=lux.
bugs.actual: Win at cycle 32. Lux seeds 1 to 3 win at 27. Last round lux was 27, 27, 29, none.

steps: Measured spent (sum of skill_log costs) plus skill_points_left at cycle 39 in focus runs: qa/reports/2026-11-05-more-skills-signoff-runs.jsonl (reg_* arms).
Second-market arm: --skills=FND_STORAGE,FND_PERMIT,FND_PROSPECT,LUX_1,LUX_3,LUX_5,LUX_5B,LUX_6B,LUX_7,MIL_1,MIL_3,MIL_5,MIL_5B (24 points) with no focus.
bugs.expected: About 21 points of supply per run (economy handoff T173-r2), so a focus uses about 19 and a second market does not fit.
bugs.actual: Points earned by cycle 39 vary by market: mil 16 to 19, default 19 to 22, bio 17 to 18, lux 22 to 25, min 27 to 29 (share steps pay points). The second-market arm (24 whitelisted points plus FND_BULK, auto-allowed = 26) spends 19 to 21, so it does not fit at mil or default supply. Lux and min supply (22 to 29) is above the 21-point premise, so the premise is not fixed across runs.

steps: Run reg_default (all skills) and --skip-skill=FND_BULK, seeds 1 to 4, fast clock.
Read cash_by_cycle at cycles 1 to 10 and ship_buys.
bugs.expected: FND_BULK does not make the first 10 cycles risky for cash.
bugs.actual: Not risky: cash minimum over cycles 1 to 10 is 300 with and without (300, 300, 300, 300 vs 300, 300, 300, 284); first ship at cycle 5 in both. But cash at cycle 5 is 12 to 37 percent lower with FND_BULK (473 vs 539; 338 vs 539), and cash at cycle 10 is lower in 3 of 4 seeds (543 vs 1593; 358 vs 1948; 890 vs 1231).

steps: Branch arms (whitelist FND_STORAGE,FND_PERMIT,FND_PROSPECT,BIO_1,BIO_3,BIO_5 with and without BIO_5B): qa/reports/2026-11-05-more-skills-signoff-runs.jsonl, batch more_skills_signoff.
Note: FND_BULK is auto-allowed in every branch arm (bot_run.gd:1255-1264), so it is learned on both sides.
bugs.expected: Without BIO_5B the bio branch still runs (economy handoff: BIO_5B is a 2-point side node).
bugs.actual: Without BIO_5B the bio branch bankrupts or stalls at cash 0 or 520 in 3 of 4 seeds (win at 27 only in seed 2). With BIO_5B it wins in 3 of 4 (27, 37, 27). BIO_5B is load-bearing for the bio branch.

steps: Branch arms brb_mil_base vs brb_mil_5B, seeds 1 to 4 (whitelist FND trio, MIL_1, MIL_3, MIL_5 with and without MIL_5B).
bugs.expected: MIL_5B stock growth (1 percent a cycle, cap 10 percent) and stock protection are felt in mil focus.
bugs.actual: Growth half: mil stock in planet storage at the end differs by +7, 0, +2, +2 units; cash +0 to +176; share and win unchanged in 4 of 4. Stock protection not measured (no asteroid storage cut in the runs).

steps: Branch arms brb_lux_5B vs brb_lux_5B_6B, seeds 1 to 4; natural arms reg_lux vs nat_LUX_6B.
bugs.expected: The 0.3 cut on lux price-down events is felt in lux focus.
bugs.actual: Lux price-down events start 0 or 1 time per run (mean 0.5). The cut binds in 1 of 4 seeds (+3.1k cash, same win), and that seed's event sequence also changed, so it is not clean. Share and win unchanged in the other seeds.

steps: Branch arms brb_min_base vs brb_min_5B, seeds 1 to 4 (whitelist FND trio, MIN_1, MIN_3, MIN_5 with and without MIN_5B).
bugs.expected: MIN_5B debris immunity and the 0.3 min event cut are felt in min focus.
bugs.actual: Outcome identical with and without in 4 of 4 seeds (win, cash, share and event sequence). Min price-down events start 0 or 1 time per run. No debris event (EV17) started in any of 132 runs, so the immunity half never binds.

steps: Branch arm brb_bio_base vs brb_bio_6B, seeds 1 to 4 (whitelist FND trio, BIO_1, BIO_3, BIO_5 with and without BIO_6B).
Natural arm: reg_bio (BIO_6B never learned in 4 of 4).
bugs.expected: BIO_6B hit (25 percent for 4 cycles, every 8) is felt in bio focus.
bugs.actual: Not reached naturally (0 of 4 learned). When learned: fires every 8 cycles, share +0.004 to +0.007 (below 0.02 in 4 of 4), cash and win unchanged. The test base collapses in 3 of 4 seeds, so the test is weak. The shared lock itself works (see the signoff report, section 4).
